        "Read all20paths/full913-line owned C++/IDL/Rust/vendor/fake/test/build diff and bounded actual key/ID/listener/store/current consumers. Introduces nsIMsgFolder.handleViewCommand with default no-op, moves IMAP view protocol handling into its folder override and makes shared view collect local messageKeys for every folder. Version>=Exchange2013 sends MarkAsJunk with move_item=true; older server returns Processing error in this initial patch, fixed separately3375. On success, C++ validates returned-ID/header counts, locates Junk or Inbox destination, copies local headers/offline data, applies returned server IDs and deletes source headers/content. Remote move can succeed before local error/partial per-header commit; no transaction, rollback or absent-destination recovery guarantee.",
        "GetEwsIdsForMessageHeaders skips headers without a protocol ID while listener retains the original header array, so response count validation is against sent IDs and later C++ count check is against all headers. This is a bounded mismatch/failure contract, not a reproduced corruption. Success-only EwsSimpleMessageListener exposes only simple operation interface; Rust queries optional fallible interface, and inspected historical handle_error only logs when absent. Thus supplied copy listener is not guaranteed failure notification by that path. Current safe-operation framework is a later layer not fully audited for all retries/failures.",

Fake MarkAsJunk handler moves stored items and returns IDs; vendor tests assert wire serialization/deserialization separately. New vendor assertion-helper calls accept no message parameter and underlying unchanged helpers use assert_eq without explicit expected-behavior message; imported test style is not a Thunderbird-wide convention.",

This is scoped change planning and accepted local architecture, not a ban on functional programming, reuse, or a mandate to duplicate errors.",

Exact caller preserves expanded headers order into keys; GetHeadersFromSelection appends real selected header before its collapsed children, while old helper uses first tree range.
